tools.name: lookup_trombone_slide_position
tools.description: Look up primary slide position (1st to 7th), F-attachment trigger position, alternate positions, and harmonic pitch tendencies (e.g. flat 6th partial / sharp 5th partial) for any trombone note (e.g. "Bb2", "C3", "F3", "Bb3", "D4", "F4").
